Deferred taxes in 60 seconds ⏱️

Book and tax recognize the same item in different years. That gap is a temporary difference – and it reverses later.

Example: $100,000 equipment. Book carrying amount after year 1: $80,000. Tax basis: $50,000. Difference $30,000 × 21% federal rate = $6,300 deferred tax liability.

Easy on one asset. Messy across hundreds of differences, rate changes and state blends – that's where spreadsheets break.

📌 Save this for your next provision.
